businesses.name: Orbit Healthcare, Inc
businesses.what_they_do: Healthcare administrative automation company: a suite of AI agents for referral management, patient access/eligibility, prior authorisation and revenue cycle, plus APIs for healthcare software partners to embed those capabilities. Now leads with 'Orbit AI Workforce' after a longer healthcare IT services history.
businesses.customers: Healthcare provider organisations and RCM/operations leaders, plus healthcare software vendors and technology partners building on its APIs.

size_signals.signal: Home page stats: 15+ years in healthcare, 11,000+ deployments, 100M+ documents processed, 5,000+ payer connections
SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance claims
Google profile 5.0 rating, category 'Computer consultant', 77 Milltown Rd b8
Counted as a client/partner logo on another East Brunswick IT firm's site

listing.reviews: count not shown in Google's limited Maps view; profile is missing the phone number and photos

website_review.primary_cta: 'Let's Talk' in the header and 'Get started' / 'Book a Demo' on the contact page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: 'Book a Demo' form protected by Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise (invisible) - no self-serve calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Deployment and document-volume stats, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, payer connections, named product domains, HQ address in the footer
website_review.search_basics: Title and description are precise ('Orbit Healthcare | AI Agents that power healthcare operations'), single H1, per-workflow agent pages exist; no JSON-LD at all despite being a B2B software company
top_issues: No schema.org markup on a site selling software to healthcare buyers
Phone number appears only as footer text and is buried; the Google profile has no phone at all
Demo request is gated behind reCAPTCHA Enterprise with no alternate booking path
Google category is 'Computer consultant', which mis-describes a healthcare AI product company

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt allows all with a sitemap. Google profile is claimed with hours and rating but prompts 'Add place's phone number' and has no photos. On-site, product capabilities are described thoroughly in text and the HQ address plus two phone numbers appear in the footer, but there is no price information and no JSON-LD. The 'Book a Demo' page loads Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise and exposes no plain form element in the DOM, so an agent cannot reliably complete the request.

operations_signals.signal: Two published numbers (732.333.3619 and 732.561.9181) plus a 'Support Request' link and an 'Online Whistleblower Form' - multiple intake queues
Demo booking is a form promising a technology specialist follow-up
Two distinct go-to-market paths (operations teams vs API partners) requiring different qualification

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add Organization/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD and complete the Google profile (phone, photos, correct category) so AI assistants and maps describe them accurately.
top_opportunities.evidence: Zero ld+json scripts detected; Google prompts to add the phone number and the category reads 'Computer consultant'.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Offer a no-CAPTCHA booking path (self-serve calendar plus an agent-friendly fallback) so partner and buyer agents can secure a demo slot.
top_opportunities.evidence: Book a Demo page loads reCAPTCHA Enterprise and shows no plain form element in the DOM.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish packaging/pricing ranges for the agent modules and a partner onboarding page with concrete next steps.
top_opportunities.evidence: Site explains capabilities in depth but states no price or engagement model anywhere I read.

scores.reasons: Gap: strong, current site; misses schema, profile completeness and an agent-completable demo path. Pay: funded-looking healthcare AI vendor with SOC 2 and large deployment claims. Ease: markup and profile fixes are quick, though they may prefer in-house work. Evidence: home page, contact page DOM (reCAPTCHA, form absence), robots.txt and Maps profile.

businesses.name: TCA Associates Inc
businesses.website: none - tcaassociates.com does not resolve (HTTP and DNS fail in browser and fetch layer)
businesses.what_they_do: Listed in directories as an IT/computer consulting business at 557 Cranbury Rd Suite 16, East Brunswick. No current website and no verifiable service description beyond the directory category.

size_signals.signal: Only directory entries found: a computer-consultant category listing at 557 Cranbury Rd, with two different phone numbers across directories
NJ employment-personnel registry entries for similarly named firms are expired, so nothing corroborates current trading status

website_review.out_of_date_signs: Domain does not resolve; Chrome returns a network error page for both http and https
website_review.search_basics: No site and no Google Business Profile - a search for the address returns a medical practice instead, so nothing is indexed under this name
top_issues: No working website and no Google Business Profile; the business is effectively invisible online
Conflicting phone numbers across directories - the batch number could not be corroborated

agent_readiness.notes: No Google listing found at the address (search resolves to an ENT practice), no robots.txt because the domain is dead, and no text, form or booking of any kind. Nothing for an AI agent to retrieve.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Confirm the business is still trading before any engagement; if it is, the first fix is a minimal site with a working phone and a contact form.
top_opportunities.evidence: Both the domain and the Google listing are absent; only stale directory rows remain.

scores.reasons: Gap: total absence of web presence. Pay: no evidence of trading activity or budget. Ease: nothing to fix until existence is confirmed. Evidence: directory listings only, conflicting phone numbers, domain does not resolve.

caveats: Google review counts are not displayed in the limited Maps view the browser receives; only the star rating is visible, so the reviews field is generally a rating only. Where a count appears it came from an aggregator and is labelled as such.

Two batch records no longer match the companies' published addresses: E-Business International now lists 1100 Cornwall Rd, Monmouth Junction, and Hire IT People's Google profile shows 15 Corporate Pl S in the Piscataway area, while the batch has East Brunswick addresses. Location drift is labelled as such in each entry.

C Squared Networks has rebranded to Digital Bodyguards; csquarednetworks.com now redirects to digitalbodyguards.com and its Google reviews sit on a Brick-address profile, with a duplicate unclaimed listing at 434 NJ-18.
The browser tool appeared to prepend an emoji to some page titles; any emoji seen in a title was treated as a tool artefact and not reported as a site problem.

Loyal Tech's primary domain served a Cloudflare challenge to the browser at both desktop and 390px widths, so its site could not be reviewed as a customer would see it; the review is based on the challenge page plus the secondary domain loyaltechandsecurity.com.
data_gaps: TCA Associates: could not confirm the business operates - tcaassociates.com does not resolve, no Google Business Profile exists at 557 Cranbury Rd, and directory phone numbers conflict.
Hire IT People: the site is unreachable (NXDOMAIN), so no website review was possible; whether the firm has a replacement site under another domain is unknown.

Review counts and review text (customer complaints about response times, missed calls, scheduling) could not be read for most firms; the Maps view available here does not expose review bodies, so operations signals are largely inferred from site forms and hiring activity.
No job-posting counts were collected beyond one externally hosted posting for Loyal Tech; Indeed and LinkedIn job boards were not opened.
